segments.sn51.26:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti,
segments.sn51.26:1.8: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā satta phalā sattānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
segments.sn51.26:2.2: Diṭṭheva dhamme paṭikacca [paṭigacca (sī.), paṭihacca (pī.)] aññaṃ ārādheti
segments.sn51.26:2.3: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti; atha maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti,
segments.sn51.26:2.4: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti, no ce maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti; atha pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti, upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī.
segments.sn51.26:2.5: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ime satta phalā sattānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā”ti.

lines: Apica dve phalāni ādiṃ katvā heṭṭhā missakiddhipādā kathitā, sattasu phalesu pubbabhāgā.
“Dvinnaṃ phalāna”nti āgatasuttaṃ sandhāya “dve phalāni ādiṃ katvā”ti vuttaṃ.
